topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Can you believe it? We've been chatting for months, sharing everything, and then it turns out they live like five blocks from me. I mean, really? We could have grabbed coffee, or hit up that new bookstore. All this time, I'm sharing my life with this person like they're miles away, and they're practically my neighbor! Sure, we've had our laughs and deep talks, but now I just feel like I've been played, you know? Like, why keep that to yourself? It’s not like a city’s a secret. I don’t even know what to think anymore. Maybe I’ll reach out, but honestly, I just feel so let down right now.
